analysis_set.span: Overall number of participants analyzed = full analysis set (FAS) which comprised all randomized participants. Number Analyzed = number of participants with available data.

follow_up.span: The co–primary end points, in the order planned for sequential hierarchic testing, were the percentage change in body weight and the proportion of participants who lost at least 5% of baseline weight by week 68

entry_age.span: Eligible participants were aged 18 years or older

notes: The served observed in-trial means use available cases (373/189), not the randomized totals (407/204) attached to them. Full-text Statistical Analysis confirms efficacy analyses used all randomized participants, with multiple imputation for the treatment-policy estimand; this does not validate the served reconstruction. The registry treatment-policy ANCOVA MD is -10.27 (95% CI -11.97 to -8.57). Entry criteria describe a subset within the question's population; no out-of-question entry population was identified.
